# CertScore.ai

CertScore.ai scans public websites for observable privacy, cookie, consent, tracking, accessibility, session recording, and fingerprinting-related risk signals.

## Important disclaimer

CertScore.ai automated findings may contain errors. Always review the underlying evidence. CertScore.ai does not provide legal advice or certify compliance.
